name: Barbell hip thrust

phases.name: drive
phases.cue: Drive through your heels — hips up

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Brace, chin tucked, upper back on the bench

formTips: Rest your upper back, just below the shoulder blades, across the edge of the bench
Roll the bar over your hip crease, using a pad, and hold it in place with both hands
Plant your feet about hip-width so your shins are upright at the top
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down, moving your head with your torso
Finish with your torso and thighs level and your glutes squeezed hard
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to get the hips higher
Pushing through the toes so the heels lift
Feet too far forward or back, so the hamstrings or quads take over
